dict.string: Gary 2.0 - Snapshot live scores into Supabase every 2 minutes (cheap cached no-op when nothing is live).

array.string: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="/Users/adam.preda/.local/share/gary/runtimes/node-v22.23.2-darwin-arm64/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"; cd /Users/adam.preda/Gary2.0/gary2.0 || exit $?; gary_try=0; while :; do gary_try=$((gary_try+1)); gary_t0=$(date +%s); node scripts/poll-live-scores.js; gary_rc=$?; gary_dt=$(( $(date +%s) - gary_t0 )); if [ "$gary_rc" -ne 0 ] && [ "$gary_dt" -le 15 ] && [ "$gary_try" -lt 3 ]; then echo "scripts/poll-live-scores.js died within ${gary_dt}s (rc=$gary_rc) — startup retry $gary_try/2 after 5s (Sep 2 2026: launchd node EINTR uv_cwd)" >&2; sleep 5; continue; fi; break; done; exit "$gary_rc"
